mn73:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
mn73:2.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn73:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn73:3.2: sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo saṃkhittena kusalākusalaṃ desetū’ti.
mn73:3.3: saṃkhittenapi kho te ahaṃ vaccha kusalākusalaṃ deseyyaṃ, vitthārenapi kho te ahaṃ vaccha kusalākusalaṃ deseyyaṃ.
mn73:3.4: api ca te ahaṃ vaccha saṃkhittena kusalākusalaṃ desissāmi.
mn73:3.5: taṃ suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmīti.
mn73:3.6: evaṃ bhoti kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavato paccassosi.
mn73:4.1: lobho kho vaccha akusalaṃ, alobho kusalaṃ.
mn73:4.2: doso kho vaccha akusalaṃ, adoso kusalaṃ.
mn73:4.3: moho kho vaccha akusalaṃ, amoho kusalaṃ.
mn73:4.4: iti kho vaccha ime tayo dhammā akusalā, tayo dhammā kusalā.
mn73:5.1: pāṇātipāto kho vaccha akusalaṃ, pāṇātipātā veramaṇī kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.2: adinnādānaṃ kho vaccha akusalaṃ, adinnādānā veramaṇī kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.3: kāmesumicchācāro kho vaccha akusalaṃ, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.4: musāvādo kho vaccha akusalaṃ, musāvādā veramaṇī kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.5: pisuṇā vācā kho vaccha akusalaṃ, pisunā vācā veramaṇī kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.6: pharusā vācā kho vaccha akusalaṃ, pharusā vācā veramaṇī kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.7: samphappalāpā kho vaccha akusalaṃ, samphappalāpā veramaṇī kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.8: abhijjhā kho vaccha akusalaṃ, anabhijjhā kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.9: byāpādo kho vaccha akusalaṃ, abyāpādo kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.10: micchādiṭṭhi kho vaccha akusalaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi kusalaṃ.
mn73:5.11: iti kho vaccha ime dasa dhammā akusalā, dasa dhammā kusalā.
mn73:6.1: yato kho vaccha bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. so hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimuttoti.
mn73:7.2: atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekabhikkhūpi sāvako āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
mn73:7.3: na kho vaccha ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni, atha kho bhiyyova ye bhikkhū mama sāvakā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti.
mn73:8.2: atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekabhikkhunīpi sāvikā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
mn73:8.3: na kho vaccha ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni. atha kho bhiyyova yā bhikkhuniyo mama sāvikā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti.
mn73:9.1: tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhū, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhuniyo.
mn73:9.2: atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekupāsakopi sāvako gihī odātavasano brahmacārī pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokāti.
mn73:9.3: na kho vaccha ekaṃyeva sataṃ na dve satāni na tīṇi satāni na cattāri satāni na pañca satāni. atha kho bhiyyova ye upāsakā mama sāvakā gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā tasmā lokāti.
mn73:10.1: tiṭṭhatu bhavaṃ gotamo, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhū, tiṭṭhantu bhikkhuniyo, tiṭṭhantu upāsakā gihī odātavasanā brahmacārino.
mn73:10.2: atthi pana bhoto gotamassa ekupāsakopi sāvako gihī odātavasano kāmabhogī sāsanakaro ovādapatikaro tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane viharatīti.

mn73:13.1: sace hi bho gotama imaṃ dhammaṃ bhavaññeva gotamo ārādhako abhavissa. no ca kho bhikkhū ārādhakā abhaviṃsu.

mn73:14.1: seyyathāpi bho gotama gaṅgānadī samuddaninnā samuddapoṇā samuddapabbhārā samuddaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati. evamevāyaṃ bhoto gotamassa parisā sagahaṭṭhapabbajitā nibbānaninnā nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā nibbānaṃ āhacca tiṭṭhati.
mn73:15.2: esāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn73:15.3: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
mn73:16.1: yo kho vaccha aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ. so cattāro māse parivasati. catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti, upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya.
mn73:16.3: sace bhante aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ cattāro māse parivasanti. catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti, upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi. catunnaṃ maṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu, upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyāti.
mn73:16.4: alattha kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
mn73:17.1: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā vacchagotto addhamāsūpasampanno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā vacchagotto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn73:17.2: ‘yāvatakaṃ bhante sekhena ñāṇena sekhāya vijjāya pattabbaṃ, anuppattaṃ taṃ mayā
mn73:18.1: tena hi tvaṃ vaccha, dve dhamme uttariṃ bhāvehi, samathañca vipassanañca.
mn73:18.2: ime kho te vaccha dve dhammā uttariṃ bhāvitā, samatho ca vipassanā ca. anekadhātupaṭivedhāya saṃvattissanti.
mn73:19.2: anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ, ekopi hutvā bahudhā assaṃ, bahudhāpi hutvā eko assaṃ, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gaccheyyaṃ seyyathāpi ākāse paṭhaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ kareyyaṃ seyyathāpi udake, udakepi abhejjamāne gaccheyyaṃ seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ, ākāsepi pallaṅkena kameyyaṃ seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo, imepi candimasuriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parimaseyyaṃ, parimajjeyyaṃ, yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyya’nti.
mn73:19.3: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi sati sati āyatane.
mn73:20.2: dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇeyyaṃ, dibbe ca mānuse ca, ye dūre santike cāti tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi sati sati āyatane.
mn73:21.2: parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajāneyyaṃ.
mn73:21.3: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.4: vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.5: sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.6: vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.7: samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.8: vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.9: saṅkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ saṅkhittaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.10: vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ vikkhittaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.11: mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ mahaggataṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.12: amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ amahaggataṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.13: sa uttaraṃ vā cittaṃ sauttaraṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.14: anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ anuttaraṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.15: samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samāhitaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.16: asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.17: vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyaṃ,
mn73:21.18: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajāneyyanti.
mn73:21.19: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi sati sati āyatane.
mn73:22.2: anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyaṃ, seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsatimpi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe, amutrāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra upapādiṃ. tatrāpāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussareyyanti.
mn73:22.3: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi sati sati āyatane.
mn73:23.2: dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajāneyyaṃ, ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā. ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā, te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppannā’ti. iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajāneyyanti.
mn73:23.3: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi sati sati āyatane.
mn73:24.2: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti.
mn73:24.3: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇissasi, sati sati āyataneti.
mn73:25.1: atha kho āyasmā vacchagotto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
mn73:26.1: atha kho āyasmā vacchagotto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
mn73:26.2: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
mn73:26.3: aññataro ca kho panāyasmā vacchagotto arahataṃ ahosi.
mn73:27.1: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ dassanāya gacchanti
mn73:27.2: addasā kho āyasmā vacchagotto te bhikkhū dūratova gacchante.
mn73:27.3: disvāna yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
mn73:27.4: handa kahaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto gacchathā’ti
mn73:27.5: bhagavantaṃ kho mayaṃ āvuso dassanāya gacchāmāti.
mn73:27.6: tena’hāyasmanto mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha, evaṃ ca vadetha.
mn73:27.7: ‘vacchagotto bhante bhikkhu bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, evañca vadeti,
mn73:27.8: pariciṇṇo me bhagavā pariciṇṇo me sugato’ti.
mn73:28.1: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato vacchagottassa paccassosuṃ.
mn73:28.2: atha kho te bhikkhū yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn73:28.3: āyasmā bhante vacchagotto bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, evañca vadeti:
mn73:28.4: pariciṇṇo me bhagavā, pariciṇṇo me sugato’ti.
mn73:28.5: pubbeva me bhikkhave vacchagotto bhikkhu cetasā ceto paricca vidito.
mn73:28.8: tevijjo bhante vacchagotto bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo’ti.
mn73:28.10: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
